entities.summary: Justin Smith, nicknamed "the Cowboy", is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end in the National Football League (NFL) for 14 seasons. He played college football for the Missouri Tigers, earning All-American honors. He played for the Cincinnati Bengals for seven seasons after being chosen with the fourth overall pick in the 2001 NFL draft. Smith also played seven seasons for the San Francisco 49ers.
